blocks.title: Prayer to God in Time of Trouble

texts.NIV84: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.
texts.KJV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
texts.NASB95:
Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation;
O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man!
texts.DRB: A psalm for David. Judge me, O God, and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy : deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.
texts.ESV:
Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause
    against an ungodly people,
from the deceitful and unjust man
    deliver me!

texts.NIV84: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
texts.KJV: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
texts.NASB95:
For You are the God of my strength; why have You rejected me?
Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
texts.DRB: For thou art God my strength : why hast thou cast me off? and why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicteth me?
texts.ESV:
For you are the God in whom I take refuge;
    why have you rejected me?
Why do I go about mourning
    because of the oppression of the enemy?

texts.NIV84: Send forth your light and your truth, let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
texts.KJV: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
texts.NKJV:
Oh, send out Your light and Your truth!
Let them lead me;
Let them bring me to Your holy hill
And to Your tabernacle.
texts.DRB: Send forth thy light and thy truth : they have conducted me, and brought me unto thy holy hill, and into thy tabernacles.

texts.NIV84: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.
texts.KJV: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
texts.NKJV:
Then I will go to the altar of God,
To God my exceeding joy;
And on the harp I will praise You,
O God, my God.
texts.DRB: And I will go in to the altar of God : to God who giveth joy to my youth.
texts.ESV:
Then I will go to the altar of God,
    to God my exceeding joy,
and I will praise you with the lyre,
    O God, my God.

texts.NIV84: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
texts.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
texts.NASB95:
Why are you in despair, O my soul?
And why are you disturbed within me?
Hope in God, for I shall again praise Him,
The help of my countenance and my God.
texts.NKJV:
Why are you cast down, O my soul?
And why are you disquieted within me?
Hope in God;
For I shall yet praise Him,
The help of my countenance and my God.
texts.DRB: To thee, O God my God, I will give praise upon the harp : why art thou sad, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me? Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him : the salvation of my countenance, and my God.
texts.ESV:
Why are you cast down, O my soul,
    and why are you in turmoil within me?
Hope in God; for I shall again praise him,
    my salvation and my God.

texts.NIV84: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.
texts.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to me, O God, according to Your lovingkindness;
According to the greatness of Your compassion blot out my transgressions.
texts.NKJV:
Have mercy upon me, O God,
According to Your lovingkindness;
According to the multitude of Your tender mercies,
Blot out my transgressions.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, a psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came to him after he had sinned with Bethsabee. Have mercy on me, O God, according to thy great mercy. And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my iniquity.
texts.ESV:
Have mercy on me, O God,
    according to your steadfast love;
according to your abundant mercy
    blot out my transgressions.

texts.NIV84: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
texts.KJV: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
texts.NASB95:
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity
And cleanse me from my sin.
texts.NKJV:
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity,
And cleanse me from my sin.
texts.DRB: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
texts.ESV:
Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity,
    and cleanse me from my sin!

texts.NIV84: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
texts.KJV: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
texts.NASB95:
For I know my transgressions,
And my sin is ever before me.
texts.NKJV:
For I acknowledge my transgressions,
And my sin is always before me.
texts.DRB: For I know my iniquity, and my sin is always before me.
texts.ESV:
For I know my transgressions,
    and my sin is ever before me.

texts.NIV84: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are proved right when you speak and justified when you judge.
texts.KJV: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
texts.NASB95:
Against You, You only, I have sinned
And done what is evil in Your sight,
So that You are justified when You speak
And blameless when You judge.
texts.NKJV:
Against You, You only, have I sinned,
And done this evil in Your sight—
That You may be found just when You speak,
And blameless when You judge.
texts.DRB: To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: that thou mayst be justified in thy words and mayst overcome when thou art judged.
texts.ESV:
Against you, you only, have I sinned
    and done what is evil in your sight,
so that you may be justified in your words
    and blameless in your judgment.

texts.NIV84: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.
texts.KJV: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity,
And in sin my mother conceived me.
texts.NKJV:
Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity,
And in sin my mother conceived me.
texts.DRB: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; and in sins did my mother conceive me.
texts.ESV:
Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity,
    and in sin did my mother conceive me.

texts.NIV84: Surely you desire truth in the inner parts; you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
texts.KJV: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, You desire truth in the innermost being,
And in the hidden part You will make me know wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts,
And in the hidden part You will make me to know wisdom.
texts.DRB: For behold thou hast loved truth: the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.
texts.ESV:
Behold, you delight in truth in the inward being,
    and you teach me wisdom in the secret heart.

texts.NIV84: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
texts.KJV: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
texts.NASB95:
Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean;
Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
texts.NKJV:
Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean;
Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
texts.DRB: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.
texts.ESV:
Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean;
    wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

texts.NIV84: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
texts.KJV: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
texts.NASB95:
Make me to hear joy and gladness,
Let the bones which You have broken rejoice.
texts.NKJV:
Make me hear joy and gladness,
That the bones You have broken may rejoice.
texts.DRB: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.
texts.ESV:
Let me hear joy and gladness;
    let the bones that you have broken rejoice.

texts.NIV84: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.
texts.KJV: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
texts.NASB95:
Hide Your face from my sins
And blot out all my iniquities.
texts.NKJV:
Hide Your face from my sins,
And blot out all my iniquities.
texts.DRB: Turn away thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
texts.ESV:
Hide your face from my sins,
    and blot out all my iniquities.

texts.NIV84: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
texts.KJV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
texts.NASB95:
Create in me a clean heart, O God,
And renew a steadfast spirit within me.
texts.NKJV:
Create in me a clean heart, O God,
And renew a steadfast spirit within me.
texts.DRB: Create a clean heart in me, O God: and renew a right spirit within my bowels.
texts.ESV:
Create in me a clean heart, O God,
    and renew a right spirit within me.

texts.NIV84: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.
texts.KJV: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
texts.NASB95:
Do not cast me away from Your presence
And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
texts.NKJV:
Do not cast me away from Your presence,
And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
texts.DRB: Cast me not away from thy face; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
texts.ESV:
Cast me not away from your presence,
    and take not your Holy Spirit from me.

texts.NIV84: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.
texts.KJV: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
texts.NASB95:
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation
And sustain me with a willing spirit.
texts.NKJV:
Restore to me the joy of Your salvation,
And uphold me by Your generous Spirit.
texts.DRB: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.
texts.ESV:
Restore to me the joy of your salvation,
    and uphold me with a willing spirit.

texts.NIV84: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.
texts.KJV: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
texts.NASB95:
Then I will teach transgressors Your ways,
And sinners will be converted to You.
texts.NKJV:
Then I will teach transgressors Your ways,
And sinners shall be converted to You.
texts.DRB: I will teach the unjust thy ways: and the wicked shall be converted to thee.
texts.ESV:
Then I will teach transgressors your ways,
    and sinners will return to you.

texts.NIV84: Save me from bloodguilt, O God, the God who saves me, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.
texts.KJV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
texts.NASB95:
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation;
Then my tongue will joyfully sing of Your righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God,
The God of my salvation,
And my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.
texts.DRB: Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall extol thy justice.
texts.ESV:
Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God,
    O God of my salvation,
    and my tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

texts.NIV84: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
texts.KJV: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
texts.NASB95:
O Lord, open my lips,
That my mouth may declare Your praise.
texts.NKJV:
O Lord, open my lips,
And my mouth shall show forth Your praise.
texts.DRB: O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: and my mouth shall declare thy praise.
texts.ESV:
O Lord, open my lips,
    and my mouth will declare your praise.

texts.NIV84: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.
texts.KJV: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
texts.NASB95:
For You do not delight in sacrifice, otherwise I would give it;
You are not pleased with burnt offering.
texts.NKJV:
For You do not desire sacrifice, or else I would give it;
You do not delight in burnt offering.
texts.DRB: For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.
texts.ESV:
For you will not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it;
    you will not be pleased with a burnt offering.

texts.NIV84: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
texts.KJV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
texts.NASB95:
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit;
A broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
texts.NKJV:
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit,
A broken and a contrite heart—
These, O God, You will not despise.
texts.DRB: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
texts.ESV:
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit;
    a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

texts.NIV84: In your good pleasure make Zion prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
texts.KJV: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
texts.NASB95:
By Your favor do good to Zion;
Build the walls of Jerusalem.
texts.NKJV:
Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion;
Build the walls of Jerusalem.
texts.DRB: Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.
texts.ESV:
Do good to Zion in your good pleasure;
    build up the walls of Jerusalem;

texts.NIV84: Then there will be righteous sacrifices, whole burnt offerings to delight you; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
texts.KJV: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
texts.DRB: Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

texts.NIV84: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
texts.KJV: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
texts.NASB95:
Save me, O God, by Your name,
And vindicate me by Your power.
texts.NKJV:
Save me, O God, by Your name,
And vindicate me by Your strength.
texts.DRB: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me in thy strength.
texts.ESV:
O God, save me by your name,
    and vindicate me by your might.

texts.NIV84: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
texts.KJV: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
texts.NASB95:
Hear my prayer, O God;
Give ear to the words of my mouth.
texts.NKJV:
Hear my prayer, O God;
Give ear to the words of my mouth.
texts.DRB: O God, hear my prayer: give ear to the words of my mouth.
texts.ESV:
O God, hear my prayer;
    give ear to the words of my mouth.

texts.NIV84: Strangers are attacking me; ruthless men seek my life- men without regard for God. Selah
texts.KJV: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
texts.DRB: For strangers have risen up against me; and the mighty have sought after my soul: and they have not set God before their eyes.

texts.NIV84: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.
texts.KJV: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
texts.NASB95:
Behold, God is my helper;
The Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
texts.NKJV:
Behold, God is my helper;
The Lord is with those who uphold my life.
texts.DRB: For behold God is my helper: and the Lord is the protector of my soul.
texts.ESV:
Behold, God is my helper;
    the Lord is the upholder of my life.

texts.NIV84: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
texts.KJV: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
texts.NASB95:
He will recompense the evil to my foes;
Destroy them in Your faithfulness.
texts.NKJV:
He will repay my enemies for their evil.
Cut them off in Your truth.
texts.DRB: Turn back the evils upon my enemies; and cut them off in thy truth.
texts.ESV:
He will return the evil to my enemies;
    in your faithfulness put an end to them.

texts.NIV84: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, O LORD, for it is good.
texts.KJV: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.
texts.NASB95:
Willingly I will sacrifice to You;
I will give thanks to Your name, O Lord, for it is good.
texts.NKJV:
I will freely sacrifice to You;
I will praise Your name, O Lord, for it is good.
texts.DRB: I will freely sacrifice to thee, and will give praise, O God, to thy name: because it is good:
texts.ESV:
With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you;
    I will give thanks to your name, O Lord, for it is good.

texts.NIV84: For he has delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
texts.KJV: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
texts.NASB95:
For He has delivered me from all trouble,
And my eye has looked with satisfaction upon my enemies.
texts.NKJV:
For He has delivered me out of all trouble;
And my eye has seen its desire upon my enemies.
texts.DRB: For thou hast delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye hath looked down upon my enemies.
texts.ESV:
For he has delivered me from every trouble,
    and my eye has looked in triumph on my enemies.

texts.NIV84: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
texts.KJV: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
texts.NASB95:
Give ear to my prayer, O God;
And do not hide Yourself from my supplication.
texts.NKJV:
Give ear to my prayer, O God,
And do not hide Yourself from my supplication.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, in verses, understanding for David. Hear, O God, my prayer, and despise not my supplication:
texts.ESV:
Give ear to my prayer, O God,
    and hide not yourself from my plea for mercy!

texts.NIV84: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught
texts.KJV: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
texts.NASB95:
Give heed to me and answer me;
I am restless in my complaint and am surely distracted,
texts.NKJV:
Attend to me, and hear me;
I am restless in my complaint, and moan noisily,
texts.DRB: be attentive to me and hear me. I am grieved in my exercise; and am troubled,
texts.ESV:
Attend to me, and answer me;
    I am restless in my complaint and I moan,

texts.NIV84: at the voice of the enemy, at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.
texts.KJV: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
texts.NASB95:
Because of the voice of the enemy,
Because of the pressure of the wicked;
For they bring down trouble upon me
And in anger they bear a grudge against me.
texts.NKJV:
Because of the voice of the enemy,
Because of the oppression of the wicked;
For they bring down trouble upon me,
And in wrath they hate me.
texts.DRB: at the voice of the enemy, and at the tribulation of the sinner. For they have cast iniquities upon me: and in wrath they were troublesome to me.
texts.ESV:
because of the noise of the enemy,
    because of the oppression of the wicked.
For they drop trouble upon me,
    and in anger they bear a grudge against me.

texts.NIV84: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death assail me.
texts.KJV: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
texts.NASB95:
My heart is in anguish within me,
And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
texts.NKJV:
My heart is severely pained within me,
And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
texts.DRB: My heart is troubled within me: and the fear of death is fallen upon me.
texts.ESV:
My heart is in anguish within me;
    the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

texts.NIV84: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.
texts.KJV: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
texts.NASB95:
Fear and trembling come upon me,
And horror has overwhelmed me.
texts.NKJV:
Fearfulness and trembling have come upon me,
And horror has overwhelmed me.
texts.DRB: Fear and trembling are come upon me: and darkness hath covered me.
texts.ESV:
Fear and trembling come upon me,
    and horror overwhelms me.

texts.NIV84: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest-
texts.KJV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
texts.NASB95:
I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove!
I would fly away and be at rest.
texts.NKJV:
So I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove!
I would fly away and be at rest.
texts.DRB: And I said: Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly and be at rest?
texts.ESV:
And I say, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove!
    I would fly away and be at rest;

texts.NIV84: I would flee far away and stay in the desert; Selah
texts.KJV: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
“Behold, I would wander far away,
I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
Indeed, I would wander far off,
And remain in the wilderness. Selah
texts.DRB: Lo, I have gone far off flying away; and I abode in the wilderness.
texts.ESV:
yes, I would wander far away;
    I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah

texts.NIV84: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."
texts.KJV: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
texts.NASB95:
“I would hasten to my place of refuge
From the stormy wind and tempest.”
texts.NKJV:
I would hasten my escape
From the windy storm and tempest.”
texts.DRB: I waited for him that hath saved me from pusillanimity of spirit, and a storm.
texts.ESV:
I would hurry to find a shelter
    from the raging wind and tempest.”

texts.NIV84: Confuse the wicked, O Lord, confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
texts.KJV: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
texts.NASB95:
Confuse, O Lord, divide their tongues,
For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
texts.NKJV:
Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues,
For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
texts.DRB: Cast down, O Lord, and divide their tongues; for I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.
texts.ESV:
Destroy, O Lord, divide their tongues;
    for I see violence and strife in the city.

texts.NIV84: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.
texts.KJV: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
texts.NASB95:
Day and night they go around her upon her walls,
And iniquity and mischief are in her midst.
texts.NKJV:
Day and night they go around it on its walls;
Iniquity and trouble are also in the midst of it.
texts.DRB: Day and night shall iniquity surround it upon its walls: and in the midst thereof are labour,

texts.NIV84: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.
texts.KJV: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
texts.NASB95:
Destruction is in her midst;
Oppression and deceit do not depart from her streets.
texts.NKJV:
Destruction is in its midst;
Oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.
texts.DRB: and injustice. And usury and deceit have not departed from its streets.

texts.NIV84: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.
texts.KJV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
texts.NASB95:
For it is not an enemy who reproaches me,
Then I could bear it;
Nor is it one who hates me who has exalted himself against me,
Then I could hide myself from him.
texts.DRB: For if my enemy had reviled me, I would verily have borne with it. And if he that hated me had spoken great things against me, I would perhaps have hidden myself from him.
texts.ESV:
For it is not an enemy who taunts me—
    then I could bear it;
it is not an adversary who deals insolently with me—
