texts.NIV84: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,
texts.KJV: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
texts.NASB95:
But it is you, a man my equal,
My companion and my familiar friend;
texts.NKJV:
But it was you, a man my equal,
My companion and my acquaintance.
texts.DRB: But thou a man of one mind, my guide, and my familiar,
texts.ESV:
But it is you, a man, my equal,
    my companion, my familiar friend.

texts.NIV84: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship as we walked with the throng at the house of God.
texts.KJV: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
texts.NASB95:
We who had sweet fellowship together
Walked in the house of God in the throng.
texts.NKJV:
We took sweet counsel together,
And walked to the house of God in the throng.
texts.DRB: Who didst take sweetmeats together with me: in the house of God we walked with consent.
texts.ESV:
We used to take sweet counsel together;
    within God's house we walked in the throng.

texts.NIV84: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.
texts.KJV: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
texts.DRB: Let death come upon them, and let them go down alive into hell. For there is wickedness in their dwellings: in the midst of them.

texts.NIV84: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
texts.KJV: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.
texts.NASB95:
As for me, I shall call upon God,
And the Lord will save me.
texts.NKJV:
As for me, I will call upon God,
And the Lord shall save me.
texts.DRB: But I have cried to God: and the Lord will save me.
texts.ESV:
But I call to God,
    and the Lord will save me.

texts.NIV84: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.
texts.KJV: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
texts.NASB95:
Evening and morning and at noon, I will complain and murmur,
And He will hear my voice.
texts.NKJV:
Evening and morning and at noon
I will pray, and cry aloud,
And He shall hear my voice.
texts.DRB: Evening and morning, and at noon I will speak and declare: and he shall hear my voice.
texts.ESV:
Evening and morning and at noon
    I utter my complaint and moan,
    and he hears my voice.

texts.NIV84: He ransoms me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
texts.KJV: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
texts.NASB95:
He will redeem my soul in peace from the battle which is against me,
For they are many who strive with me.
texts.NKJV:
He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me,
For there were many against me.
texts.DRB: He shall redeem my soul in peace from them that draw near to me: for among many they were with me.

texts.NIV84: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear them and afflict them- Selah men who never change their ways and have no fear of God.
texts.KJV: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
texts.NASB95:
God will hear and answer them—
Even the one who sits enthroned from of old— Selah.
With whom there is no change,
And who do not fear God.
texts.NKJV:
God will hear, and afflict them,
Even He who abides from of old. Selah
Because they do not change,
Therefore they do not fear God.
texts.DRB: God shall hear, and the Eternal shall humble them. For there is no change with them, and they have not feared God:
texts.ESV:
God will give ear and humble them,
    he who is enthroned from of old, Selah
because they do not change
    and do not fear God.

texts.NIV84: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
texts.KJV: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
texts.NASB95:
He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him;
He has violated his covenant.
texts.NKJV:
He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him;
He has broken his covenant.
texts.DRB: he hath stretched forth his hand to repay. They have defiled his covenant,
texts.ESV:
My companion stretched out his hand against his friends;
    he violated his covenant.

texts.NIV84: His speech is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.
texts.KJV: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
texts.NASB95:
His speech was smoother than butter,
But his heart was war;
His words were softer than oil,
Yet they were drawn swords.
texts.NKJV:
The words of his mouth were smoother than butter,
But war was in his heart;
His words were softer than oil,
Yet they were drawn swords.
texts.DRB: they are divided by the wrath Of his countenance, and his heart hath drawn near. His words are smoother than oil, and the same are darts.
texts.ESV:
His speech was smooth as butter,
    yet war was in his heart;
his words were softer than oil,
    yet they were drawn swords.

texts.NIV84: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous fall.
texts.KJV: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
texts.NASB95:
Cast your burden upon the Lord and He will sustain you;
He will never allow the righteous to be shaken.
texts.DRB: Cast thy care upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall not suffer the just to waver for ever.
texts.ESV:
Cast your burden on the Lord,
    and he will sustain you;
he will never permit
    the righteous to be moved.

texts.NIV84: But you, O God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of corruption; bloodthirsty and deceitful men will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.
texts.KJV: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
texts.DRB: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee, O Lord.
texts.ESV:
But you, O God, will cast them down
    into the pit of destruction;
men of blood and treachery
    shall not live out half their days.
But I will trust in you.

texts.NIV84: Be merciful to me, O God, for men hotly pursue me; all day long they press their attack.
texts.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to me, O God, for man has trampled upon me;
Fighting all day long he oppresses me.
texts.NKJV:
Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up;
Fighting all day he oppresses me.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for a people that is removed at a distance from the sanctuary for David, for an inscription of a title (or pillar ) when the Philistines held him in Geth. Have mercy on me, O God, for man hath trodden me under foot; all the day long he hath afflicted me fighting against me.
texts.ESV:
Be gracious to me, O God, for man tramples on me;
    all day long an attacker oppresses me;

texts.NIV84: My slanderers pursue me all day long; many are attacking me in their pride.
texts.KJV: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
texts.NASB95:
My foes have trampled upon me all day long,
For they are many who fight proudly against me.
texts.NKJV:
My enemies would hound me all day,
For there are many who fight against me, O Most High.
texts.DRB: My enemies have trodden on me all the day long; for they are many that make war against me.
texts.ESV:
my enemies trample on me all day long,
    for many attack me proudly.

texts.NIV84: When I am afraid, I will trust in you.
texts.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
texts.NASB95:
When I am afraid,
I will put my trust in You.
texts.NKJV:
Whenever I am afraid,
I will trust in You.
texts.DRB: From the height of the day I shall fear: but I will trust in thee.
texts.ESV:
When I am afraid,
    I put my trust in you.

texts.NIV84: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mortal man do to me?
texts.KJV: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
texts.NASB95:
In God, whose word I praise,
In God I have put my trust;
I shall not be afraid.
What can mere man do to me?
texts.NKJV:
In God (I will praise His word),
In God I have put my trust;
I will not fear.
What can flesh do to me?
texts.DRB: In God I will praise my words, in God I have put my trust: I will not fear what flesh can do against me.
texts.ESV:
In God, whose word I praise,
    in God I trust; I shall not be afraid.
    What can flesh do to me?

texts.NIV84: All day long they twist my words; they are always plotting to harm me.
texts.KJV: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
texts.NASB95:
All day long they distort my words;
All their thoughts are against me for evil.
texts.NKJV:
All day they twist my words;
All their thoughts are against me for evil.
texts.DRB: All the day long they detested my words: all their thoughts were against me unto evil.
texts.ESV:
All day long they injure my cause;
    all their thoughts are against me for evil.

texts.NIV84: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, eager to take my life.
texts.KJV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
texts.NASB95:
They attack, they lurk,
They watch my steps,
As they have waited to take my life.
texts.NKJV:
They gather together,
They hide, they mark my steps,
When they lie in wait for my life.
texts.DRB: They will dwell and hide themselves: they will watch my heel. As they have waited for my soul,

texts.NIV84: On no account let them escape; in your anger, O God, bring down the nations.
texts.KJV: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
texts.NASB95:
Because of wickedness, cast them forth,
In anger put down the peoples, O God!
texts.NKJV:
Shall they escape by iniquity?
In anger cast down the peoples, O God!
texts.DRB: for nothing shalt thou save them: in thy anger thou shalt break the people in pieces, O God,
texts.ESV:
For their crime will they escape?
    In wrath cast down the peoples, O God!

texts.NIV84: Record my lament; list my tears on your scroll - are they not in your record?
texts.KJV: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
texts.DRB: I have declared to thee my life: thou hast set my tears in thy sight, As also in thy promise.

texts.NIV84: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.
texts.KJV: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
texts.NASB95:
Then my enemies will turn back in the day when I call;
This I know, that God is for me.
texts.DRB: Then shall my enemies be turned back. In what day soever I shall call upon thee, behold I know thou art my God.
texts.ESV:
Then my enemies will turn back
    in the day when I call.
    This I know, that God is for me.

texts.NIV84: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise-
texts.KJV: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.
texts.NASB95:
In God, whose word I praise,
In the Lord, whose word I praise,
texts.NKJV:
In God (I will praise His word),
In the Lord (I will praise His word),
texts.DRB: In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise his speech. In God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.
texts.ESV:
In God, whose word I praise,
    in the Lord, whose word I praise,

texts.NIV84: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
texts.KJV: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
texts.NASB95:
In God I have put my trust, I shall not be afraid.
What can man do to me?
texts.DRB: In God will I praise the word, in the Lord will I praise his speech. In God have I hoped, I will not fear what man can do to me.
texts.ESV:
in God I trust; I shall not be afraid.
    What can man do to me?

texts.NIV84: I am under vows to you, O God; I will present my thank offerings to you.
texts.KJV: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
texts.NASB95:
Your vows are binding upon me, O God;
I will render thank offerings to You.
texts.NKJV:
Vows made to You are binding upon me, O God;
I will render praises to You,
texts.DRB: In me, O God, are vows to thee, which I will pay, praises to thee:
texts.ESV:
I must perform my vows to you, O God;
    I will render thank offerings to you.

texts.NIV84: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
texts.KJV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
texts.NASB95:
For You have delivered my soul from death,
Indeed my feet from stumbling,
So that I may walk before God
In the light of the living.
texts.NKJV:
For You have delivered my soul from death.
Have You not kept my feet from falling,
That I may walk before God
In the light of the living?
texts.DRB: Because thou hast delivered my soul from death, my feet from falling: that I may please in the sight of God, in the light of the living.
texts.ESV:
For you have delivered my soul from death,
    yes, my feet from falling,
that I may walk before God
    in the light of life.

texts.NIV84: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for in you my soul takes refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.
texts.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
texts.NASB95:
Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me,
For my soul takes refuge in You;
And in the shadow of Your wings I will take refuge
Until destruction passes by.
texts.NKJV:
Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me!
For my soul trusts in You;
And in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge,
Until these calamities have passed by.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, destroy not, for David, for an inscription of a title, when he fled from Saul into the cave Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me: for my soul trusteth in thee. And in the shadow of thy wings will I hope, until iniquity pass away.
texts.ESV:
Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me,
    for in you my soul takes refuge;
in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge,
    till the storms of destruction pass by.

texts.NIV84: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who fulfills {his purpose} for me.
texts.KJV: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
texts.NASB95:
I will cry to God Most High,
To God who accomplishes all things for me.
texts.NKJV:
I will cry out to God Most High,
To God who performs all things for me.
texts.DRB: I will cry to God the most High; to God who hath done good to me.
texts.ESV:
I cry out to God Most High,
    to God who fulfills his purpose for me.

texts.NIV84: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me; Selah God sends his love and his faithfulness.
texts.KJV: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
texts.DRB: He hath sent from heaven and delivered me: he hath made them a reproach that trod upon me. God hath sent his mercy and his truth,

texts.NIV84: I am in the midst of lions; I lie among ravenous beasts- men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
texts.KJV: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
texts.NASB95:
My soul is among lions;
I must lie among those who breathe forth fire,
Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows
And their tongue a sharp sword.
texts.NKJV:
My soul is among lions;
I lie among the sons of men
Who are set on fire,
Whose teeth are spears and arrows,
And their tongue a sharp sword.
texts.DRB: and he hath delivered my soul from the midst of the young lions. I slept troubled. The sons of men, whose teeth are weapons and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
texts.ESV:
My soul is in the midst of lions;
    I lie down amid fiery beasts—
the children of man, whose teeth are spears and arrows,
    whose tongues are sharp swords.

texts.NIV84: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
texts.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
texts.NASB95:
Be exalted above the heavens, O God;
Let Your glory be above all the earth.
texts.NKJV:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
Let Your glory be above all the earth.
texts.DRB: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, and thy glory above all the earth.
texts.ESV:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens!
    Let your glory be over all the earth!

texts.NIV84: They spread a net for my feet- I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path- but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah
texts.KJV: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
texts.DRB: They prepared a snare for my feet; and they bowed down my soul. They dug a pit before my face, and they are fallen into it.
texts.ESV:
They set a net for my steps;
    my soul was bowed down.
They dug a pit in my way,
    but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah

texts.NIV84: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.
texts.KJV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
texts.NASB95:
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast;
I will sing, yes, I will sing praises!
texts.NKJV:
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast;
I will sing and give praise.
texts.DRB: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: I will Sing, and rehearse a psalm.
texts.ESV:
My heart is steadfast, O God,
    my heart is steadfast!
I will sing and make melody!

texts.NIV84: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
texts.KJV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
texts.NASB95:
Awake, my glory!
Awake, harp and lyre!
I will awaken the dawn.
texts.NKJV:
Awake, my glory!
Awake, lute and harp!
I will awaken the dawn.
texts.DRB: Arise, O my glory, arise psaltery and harp: I will arise early.
texts.ESV:
Awake, my glory!
Awake, O harp and lyre!
    I will awake the dawn!

texts.NIV84: I will praise you, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.
texts.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
texts.NASB95:
I will give thanks to You, O Lord, among the peoples;
I will sing praises to You among the nations.
texts.NKJV:
I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples;
I will sing to You among the nations.
texts.DRB: I will give praise to thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing a psalm to thee among the nations.
texts.ESV:
I will give thanks to you, O Lord, among the peoples;
    I will sing praises to you among the nations.

texts.NIV84: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
texts.KJV: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
texts.NASB95:
For Your lovingkindness is great to the heavens
And Your truth to the clouds.
texts.NKJV:
For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens,
And Your truth unto the clouds.
texts.DRB: For thy mercy is magnified even to the heavens: and thy truth unto the clouds.
texts.ESV:
For your steadfast love is great to the heavens,
    your faithfulness to the clouds.

texts.NIV84: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
texts.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
texts.NASB95:
Be exalted above the heavens, O God;
Let Your glory be above all the earth.
texts.NKJV:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
Let Your glory be above all the earth.
texts.DRB: Be thou exalted, O God, above the l heavens: and thy glory above all the earth.
texts.ESV:
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens!
    Let your glory be over all the earth!

blocks.title: Prayer for Restored Favor of God

texts.NIV84: You have rejected us, O God, and burst forth upon us; you have been angry-now restore us!
texts.KJV: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
texts.NASB95:
O God, You have rejected us. You have broken us;
You have been angry; O, restore us.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed, for the inscription of a title, to David himself, for doctrine, when he set fire to Mesopotamia of Syria and Sobal and Joab returned and slew of Edom, in the vale of the saltpits, twelve thousand men. O God, thou hast cast us off, and hast destroyed us; thou hast been angry, and hast had mercy on us.
texts.ESV:
O God, you have rejected us, broken our defenses;
    you have been angry; oh, restore us.

texts.NIV84: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.
texts.KJV: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
texts.NASB95:
You have made the land quake, You have split it open;
Heal its breaches, for it totters.
texts.DRB: Thou hast moved the earth, and hast troubled it: heal thou the breaches thereof, for it has been moved.
texts.ESV:
You have made the land to quake; you have torn it open;
    repair its breaches, for it totters.

texts.NIV84: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.
texts.KJV: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
texts.NASB95:
You have made Your people experience hardship;
You have given us wine to drink that makes us stagger.
texts.NKJV:
You have shown Your people hard things;
You have made us drink the wine of confusion.
texts.DRB: Thou hast shewn thy people hard things; thou hast made us drink wine of sorrow.
texts.ESV:
You have made your people see hard things;
    you have given us wine to drink that made us stagger.

texts.NIV84: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow. Selah
texts.KJV: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
You have given a banner to those who fear You,
That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
You have given a banner to those who fear You,
That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
texts.DRB: Thou hast given a warning to them that fear thee: that they may flee from before the bow: That thy beloved may be delivered.
texts.ESV:
You have set up a banner for those who fear you,
    that they may flee to it from the bow. Selah

texts.NIV84: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
texts.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
texts.NASB95:
That Your beloved may be delivered,
Save with Your right hand, and answer us!
texts.NKJV:
That Your beloved may be delivered,
Save with Your right hand, and hear me.
texts.DRB: Save me with thy right hand, and hear me.
texts.ESV:
That your beloved ones may be delivered,
    give salvation by your right hand and answer us!

texts.NIV84: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.
texts.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
texts.NASB95:
God has spoken in His holiness:
“I will exult, I will portion out Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.
texts.NKJV:
God has spoken in His holiness:
“I will rejoice;
I will divide Shechem
And measure out the Valley of Succoth.
texts.DRB: God hath spoken in his holy place: I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem; and will mete out the vale of tabernacles.
texts.ESV:
God has spoken in his holiness:
    “With exultation I will divide up Shechem
    and portion out the Vale of Succoth.

texts.NIV84: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.
texts.KJV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
texts.DRB: Galaad is mine, and Manasses is mine: and Ephraim is the strength of my head. Juda is my king:

texts.NIV84: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."
texts.KJV: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
texts.DRB: Moab is the pot of my hope. Into Edom will I stretch out my shoe: to me the foreigners are made subject.

texts.NIV84: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
texts.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
texts.NASB95:
Who will bring me into the besieged city?
Who will lead me to Edom?
texts.NKJV:
Who will bring me to the strong city?
Who will lead me to Edom?
texts.DRB: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
texts.ESV:
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
    Who will lead me to Edom?

texts.NIV84: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?
texts.KJV: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
texts.NASB95:
Have not You Yourself, O God, rejected us?
And will You not go forth with our armies, O God?
texts.NKJV:
Is it not You, O God, who cast us off?
And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?
texts.DRB: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go out with our armies?
texts.ESV:
Have you not rejected us, O God?
    You do not go forth, O God, with our armies.

texts.NIV84: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
texts.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
texts.NASB95:
O give us help against the adversary,
For deliverance by man is in vain.
texts.NKJV:
Give us help from trouble,
For the help of man is useless.
texts.DRB: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the salvation of man.
texts.ESV:
Oh, grant us help against the foe,
    for vain is the salvation of man!

texts.NIV84: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
texts.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
texts.NASB95:
Through God we shall do valiantly,
And it is He who will tread down our adversaries.
texts.NKJV:
Through God we will do valiantly,
For it is He who shall tread down our enemies.
texts.DRB: Through God we shall do mightily: and he shall bring to nothing them that afflict us.
texts.ESV:
With God we shall do valiantly;
    it is he who will tread down our foes.

texts.NIV84: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.
texts.KJV: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
texts.NASB95:
Hear my cry, O God;
Give heed to my prayer.
texts.NKJV:
Hear my cry, O God;
Attend to my prayer.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, in hymns, for David. Hear, O God, my supplication: be attentive to my prayer,
texts.ESV:
Hear my cry, O God,
    listen to my prayer;

texts.NIV84: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
texts.KJV: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
texts.NASB95:
From the end of the earth I call to You when my heart is faint;
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
texts.DRB: To thee have I cried from the ends of the earth: when my heart was in anguish, thou hast exalted me on a rock. Thou hast conducted me;
texts.ESV:
from the end of the earth I call to you
    when my heart is faint.
Lead me to the rock
    that is higher than I,

texts.NIV84: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.
texts.KJV: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
texts.NASB95:
For You have been a refuge for me,
A tower of strength against the enemy.
texts.NKJV:
For You have been a shelter for me,
A strong tower from the enemy.
texts.DRB: for thou hast been my hope; a tower of strength against the face of the enemy.
texts.ESV:
for you have been my refuge,
    a strong tower against the enemy.

texts.NIV84: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah
texts.KJV: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
texts.NASB95:
Let me dwell in Your tent forever;
Let me take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah.
texts.NKJV:
I will abide in Your tabernacle forever;
I will trust in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
texts.DRB: In thy tabernacle I shall dwell for ever: I shall be protected under the covert of thy wings.
texts.ESV:
Let me dwell in your tent forever!
    Let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings! Selah

texts.NIV84: For you have heard my vows, O God; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
texts.KJV: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
texts.NASB95:
For You have heard my vows, O God;
You have given me the inheritance of those who fear Your name.
texts.NKJV:
For You, O God, have heard my vows;
You have given me the heritage of those who fear Your name.
texts.DRB: For thou, my God, hast heard my prayer: thou hast given an inheritance to them that fear thy name.
texts.ESV:
For you, O God, have heard my vows;
    you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

texts.NIV84: Increase the days of the king's life, his years for many generations.
texts.KJV: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
texts.NASB95:
You will prolong the king’s life;
His years will be as many generations.
texts.NKJV:
You will prolong the king’s life,
His years as many generations.
texts.DRB: Thou wilt add days to the days of the king: his years even to generation and generation.
texts.ESV:
Prolong the life of the king;
    may his years endure to all generations!

texts.NIV84: May he be enthroned in God's presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.
texts.KJV: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
texts.NASB95:
He will abide before God forever;
Appoint lovingkindness and truth that they may preserve him.
texts.NKJV:
He shall abide before God forever.
Oh, prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him!
texts.DRB: He abideth for ever in the sight of God: his mercy and truth who shall search ?
texts.ESV:
May he be enthroned forever before God;
    appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!

texts.NIV84: Then will I ever sing praise to your name and fulfill my vows day after day.
texts.KJV: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
texts.NASB95:
So I will sing praise to Your name forever,
That I may pay my vows day by day.
texts.NKJV:
So I will sing praise to Your name forever,
That I may daily perform my vows.
texts.DRB: So will I sing a psalm to thy name for ever and ever: that I may pay my vows from day to day.
texts.ESV:
So will I ever sing praises to your name,
    as I perform my vows day after day.

blocks.title: Praise to God for His Salvation

texts.NIV84: Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.
texts.KJV: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
texts.NASB95:
There will be silence before You, and praise in Zion, O God,
And to You the vow will be performed.
texts.NKJV:
Praise is awaiting You, O God, in Zion;
And to You the vow shall be performed.
texts.DRB: To the end, a psalm of David. The canticle of Jeremias and Ezechiel to the people of the captivity, when they began to go out. A Hymn, O God, becometh thee in Sion: and a vow shall be paid to thee in Jerusalem.
texts.ESV:
Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion,
    and to you shall vows be performed.

texts.NIV84: O you who hear prayer, to you all men will come.
texts.KJV: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
texts.NASB95:
O You who hear prayer,
To You all men come.
texts.NKJV:
O You who hear prayer,
To You all flesh will come.
texts.DRB: O hear my prayer: all flesh shall come to thee.
texts.ESV:
O you who hear prayer,
    to you shall all flesh come.

texts.NIV84: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.
texts.KJV: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
texts.NASB95:
Iniquities prevail against me;
As for our transgressions, You forgive them.
texts.DRB: The words of the wicked have prevailed over us: and thou wilt pardon our transgressions.
texts.ESV:
When iniquities prevail against me,
    you atone for our transgressions.

texts.NIV84: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.
texts.KJV: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
texts.NASB95:
How blessed is the one whom You choose and bring near to You
To dwell in Your courts.
We will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house,
Your holy temple.
texts.NKJV:
Blessed is the man You choose,
And cause to approach You,
That he may dwell in Your courts.
We shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house,
Of Your holy temple.
texts.DRB: Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and taken to thee: he shall dwell in thy courts. We shall be filled with the good things of thy house; holy is thy temple,
texts.ESV:
Blessed is the one you choose and bring near,
    to dwell in your courts!
We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house,
    the holiness of your temple!

texts.NIV84: You answer us with awesome deeds of righteousness, O God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,
texts.KJV: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
texts.NASB95:
By awesome deeds You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation,
You who are the trust of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest sea;
texts.NKJV:
By awesome deeds in righteousness You will answer us,
O God of our salvation,
You who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth,
And of the far-off seas;
texts.DRB: wonderful in justice. Hear us, O God our saviour, who art the hope of all the ends of the earth, and in the sea afar off.
texts.ESV:
By awesome deeds you answer us with righteousness,
    O God of our salvation,
the hope of all the ends of the earth
    and of the farthest seas;

texts.NIV84: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,
texts.KJV: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
texts.NASB95:
Who establishes the mountains by His strength,
Being girded with might;
texts.NKJV:
Who established the mountains by His strength,
Being clothed with power;
texts.DRB: Thou who preparest the mountains by thy strength, being girded with power:
texts.ESV:
the one who by his strength established the mountains,
    being girded with might;

texts.NIV84: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
texts.KJV: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
texts.NASB95:
Who stills the roaring of the seas,
The roaring of their waves,
And the tumult of the peoples.
texts.NKJV:
You who still the noise of the seas,
The noise of their waves,
And the tumult of the peoples.
texts.DRB: who troublest the depth of the sea, the noise of its waves. The Gentiles shall be troubled,
texts.ESV:
who stills the roaring of the seas,
    the roaring of their waves,
    the tumult of the peoples,

texts.NIV84: Those living far away fear your wonders; where morning dawns and evening fades you call forth songs of joy.
texts.KJV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
texts.NASB95:
They who dwell in the ends of the earth stand in awe of Your signs;
You make the dawn and the sunset shout for joy.
texts.NKJV:
They also who dwell in the farthest parts are afraid of Your signs;
You make the outgoings of the morning and evening rejoice.
texts.DRB: and they that dwell in the uttermost borders shall be afraid at thy signs: thou shalt make the outgoings of the morning and of the evening to be joyful.
texts.ESV:
so that those who dwell at the ends of the earth are in awe at your signs.
You make the going out of the morning and the evening to shout for joy.

texts.NIV84: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.
texts.KJV: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
texts.DRB: Thou hast visited the earth, and hast plentifully watered it; thou hast many ways enriched it. The river of God is filled with water, thou hast prepared their food: for so is its preparation.

texts.NIV84: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.
texts.KJV: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
texts.NASB95:
You water its furrows abundantly,
You settle its ridges,
You soften it with showers,
You bless its growth.
texts.NKJV:
You water its ridges abundantly,
You settle its furrows;
You make it soft with showers,
You bless its growth.
texts.DRB: Fill up plentifully the streams thereof, multiply its fruits; it shall spring up and rejoice in its showers.
texts.ESV:
You water its furrows abundantly,
    settling its ridges,
softening it with showers,
    and blessing its growth.

texts.NIV84: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.
texts.KJV: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
texts.NASB95:
You have crowned the year with Your bounty,
And Your paths drip with fatness.
texts.NKJV:
You crown the year with Your goodness,
And Your paths drip with abundance.
texts.DRB: Thou shalt bless the crown of the year of thy goodness: and thy fields shall be filled with plenty.
texts.ESV:
You crown the year with your bounty;
    your wagon tracks overflow with abundance.

texts.NIV84: The grasslands of the desert overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.
texts.KJV: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
texts.NASB95:
The pastures of the wilderness drip,
And the hills gird themselves with rejoicing.
texts.NKJV:
They drop on the pastures of the wilderness,
And the little hills rejoice on every side.
texts.DRB: The beautiful places of the wilderness shall grow fat: and the hills shall be girded about with joy,
texts.ESV:
The pastures of the wilderness overflow,
    the hills gird themselves with joy,

texts.NIV84: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.
texts.KJV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
texts.DRB: The rams of the flock are clothed, and the vales shall abound with corn: they shall shout, yea they shall sing a hymn.
texts.ESV:
the meadows clothe themselves with flocks,
    the valleys deck themselves with grain,
    they shout and sing together for joy.

blocks.title: Praise God for His Awesome Works

texts.NIV84: Shout with joy to God, all the earth!
texts.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
texts.NASB95: Shout joyfully to God, all the earth;
texts.NKJV: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
texts.DRB: Unto the end, a canticle of a psalm of the resurrection. Shout with joy to God, all the earth,
texts.ESV: Shout for joy to God, all the earth;

texts.NIV84: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious!
texts.KJV: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
texts.NASB95:
Sing the glory of His name;
Make His praise glorious.
texts.NKJV:
Sing out the honor of His name;
Make His praise glorious.
texts.DRB: sing ye a psalm to his name; give glory to his praise.
texts.ESV:
sing the glory of his name;
    give to him glorious praise!

texts.NIV84: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.
texts.KJV: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
texts.NASB95:
Say to God, “How awesome are Your works!
Because of the greatness of Your power Your enemies will give feigned obedience to You.
texts.NKJV:
Say to God,
“How awesome are Your works!
Through the greatness of Your power
Your enemies shall submit themselves to You.
texts.DRB: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works, O Lord! in the multitude of thy strength thy enemies shall lie to thee.
texts.ESV:
Say to God, “How awesome are your deeds!
    So great is your power that your enemies come cringing to you.

texts.NIV84: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing praise to your name." Selah
texts.KJV: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
texts.DRB: Let all the earth adore thee, and sing to thee: let it sing a psalm to thy name.

texts.NIV84: Come and see what God has done, how awesome his works in man's behalf!
texts.KJV: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
texts.NASB95:
Come and see the works of God,
Who is awesome in His deeds toward the sons of men.
texts.NKJV:
Come and see the works of God;
He is awesome in His doing toward the sons of men.
texts.DRB: Come and see the works of God; who is terrible in his counsels over the sons of men.
texts.ESV:
Come and see what God has done:
    he is awesome in his deeds toward the children of man.

texts.NIV84: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot- come, let us rejoice in him.
texts.KJV: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
texts.DRB: Who turneth the sea into dry land, in the river they shall pass on foot: there shall we rejoice in him.

texts.NIV84: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations- let not the rebellious rise up against him. Selah
texts.KJV: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
texts.DRB: Who by his power ruleth for ever: his eyes behold the nations; let not them that provoke him he exalted in themselves.
texts.ESV:
who rules by his might forever,
whose eyes keep watch on the nations—
    let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

texts.NIV84: Praise our God, O peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;
texts.KJV: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
texts.NASB95:
Bless our God, O peoples,
And sound His praise abroad,
texts.NKJV:
Oh, bless our God, you peoples!
And make the voice of His praise to be heard,
texts.DRB: O bless our God, ye Gentiles: and make the voice of his praise to be heard.
texts.ESV:
Bless our God, O peoples;
    let the sound of his praise be heard,

texts.NIV84: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.
texts.KJV: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
texts.NASB95:
Who keeps us in life
And does not allow our feet to slip.
texts.NKJV:
Who keeps our soul among the living,
And does not allow our feet to be moved.
texts.DRB: Who hath set my soul to live: and hath not suffered my feet to be moved:
texts.ESV:
who has kept our soul among the living
    and has not let our feet slip.

texts.NIV84: For you, O God, tested us; you refined us like silver.
texts.KJV: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
texts.NASB95:
For You have tried us, O God;
You have refined us as silver is refined.
texts.NKJV:
For You, O God, have tested us;
You have refined us as silver is refined.
texts.DRB: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us by fire, as silver is tried.
texts.ESV:
For you, O God, have tested us;
    you have tried us as silver is tried.

texts.NIV84: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.
texts.KJV: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
texts.NASB95:
You brought us into the net;
You laid an oppressive burden upon our loins.
texts.NKJV:
You brought us into the net;
You laid affliction on our backs.
texts.DRB: Thou hast brought us into a net, thou hast laid afflictions on our back:
texts.ESV:
You brought us into the net;
    you laid a crushing burden on our backs;

texts.NIV84: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.
texts.KJV: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
texts.DRB: thou hast set men over our heads. We have passed through tire and water, and thou hast brought us out into a refreshment.

texts.NIV84: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you-
texts.KJV: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
texts.NASB95:
I shall come into Your house with burnt offerings;
I shall pay You my vows,
texts.NKJV:
I will go into Your house with burnt offerings;
I will pay You my vows,
texts.DRB: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
texts.ESV:
I will come into your house with burnt offerings;
    I will perform my vows to you,

texts.NIV84: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.
texts.KJV: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
texts.NASB95:
Which my lips uttered
And my mouth spoke when I was in distress.
texts.NKJV:
Which my lips have uttered
And my mouth has spoken when I was in trouble.
texts.DRB: which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
texts.ESV:
that which my lips uttered
    and my mouth promised when I was in trouble.

texts.NIV84: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
texts.KJV: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
texts.DRB: I will offer up to thee holocausts full of marrow, with burnt offerings of rams: I will offer to thee bullocks with goats.

texts.NIV84: Come and listen, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.
texts.KJV: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
texts.NASB95:
Come and hear, all who fear God,
And I will tell of what He has done for my soul.
texts.NKJV:
Come and hear, all you who fear God,
And I will declare what He has done for my soul.
texts.DRB: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will tell you what great things he hath done for my soul.
texts.ESV:
Come and hear, all you who fear God,
    and I will tell what he has done for my soul.

texts.NIV84: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.
texts.KJV: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
texts.NASB95:
I cried to Him with my mouth,
And He was extolled with my tongue.
texts.NKJV:
I cried to Him with my mouth,
And He was extolled with my tongue.
texts.DRB: I cried to him with my mouth: and I extolled him with my tongue.
texts.ESV:
I cried to him with my mouth,
    and high praise was on my tongue.

texts.NIV84: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;
texts.KJV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
texts.NASB95:
If I regard wickedness in my heart,
The Lord will not hear;
texts.NKJV:
If I regard iniquity in my heart,
The Lord will not hear.
texts.DRB: If I have looked at iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me.
texts.ESV:
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart,
    the Lord would not have listened.

texts.NIV84: but God has surely listened and heard my voice in prayer.
texts.KJV: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
texts.NASB95:
But certainly God has heard;
He has given heed to the voice of my prayer.
texts.NKJV:
But certainly God has heard me;
He has attended to the voice of my prayer.
texts.DRB: Therefore hath God heard me, and hath attended to the voice of my supplication.
texts.ESV:
But truly God has listened;
    he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

texts.NIV84: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!
texts.KJV: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
texts.NASB95:
Blessed be God,
Who has not turned away my prayer
Nor His lovingkindness from me.
texts.NKJV:
Blessed be God,
Who has not turned away my prayer,
Nor His mercy from me!
texts.DRB: Blessed be God, who hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
texts.ESV:
Blessed be God,
    because he has not rejected my prayer
    or removed his steadfast love from me!

blocks.title: An Urgent Plea for Help in Trouble

texts.NIV84: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
texts.KJV: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
texts.NASB95:
Save me, O God,
For the waters have threatened my life.
texts.NKJV:
Save me, O God!
For the waters have come up to my neck.
texts.DRB: Unto the end, for them that shall be changed; for David. Save me, O God: for the waters are come in even unto my soul.
texts.ESV:
Save me, O God!
    For the waters have come up to my neck.

texts.NIV84: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
texts.KJV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
texts.NASB95:
I have sunk in deep mire, and there is no foothold;
I have come into deep waters, and a flood overflows me.
texts.NKJV:
I sink in deep mire,
Where there is no standing;
I have come into deep waters,
Where the floods overflow me.
texts.DRB: I stick fast in the mire of the deep: and there is no sure standing. I am come into the depth of the sea: and a tempest hath overwhelmed me.
texts.ESV:
I sink in deep mire,
    where there is no foothold;
I have come into deep waters,
    and the flood sweeps over me.

texts.NIV84: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
texts.KJV: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
texts.NASB95:
I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched;
My eyes fail while I wait for my God.
texts.DRB: I have laboured with crying; my jaws are become hoarse: my eyes have failed, whilst I hope in my God.
texts.ESV:
I am weary with my crying out;
    my throat is parched.
My eyes grow dim
    with waiting for my God.

texts.NIV84: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.
texts.KJV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
texts.DRB: They are multiplied above the hairs of my head, who hate me without cause. My enemies are grown strong who have wrongfully persecuted me: then did I pay that which I took not away.
texts.ESV:
More in number than the hairs of my head
    are those who hate me without cause;
mighty are those who would destroy me,
    those who attack me with lies.
What I did not steal
    must I now restore?

texts.NIV84: You know my folly, O God; my guilt is not hidden from you.
texts.KJV: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
texts.NASB95:
O God, it is You who knows my folly,
And my wrongs are not hidden from You.
texts.NKJV:
O God, You know my foolishness;
And my sins are not hidden from You.
texts.DRB: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my offences are not hidden from thee:
texts.ESV:
O God, you know my folly;
    the wrongs I have done are not hidden from you.

texts.NIV84: May those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me, O Lord, the LORD Almighty; may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me, O God of Israel.
texts.KJV: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
texts.NASB95:
May those who wait for You not be ashamed through me, O Lord God of hosts;
May those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel,
texts.NKJV:
Let not those who wait for You, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed because of me;
Let not those who seek You be confounded because of me, O God of Israel.
texts.DRB: Let not them be ashamed for me, who look for thee, O Lord, the Lord of hosts. Let them not be confounded on my account, who seek thee, O God of Israel.

texts.NIV84: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.
texts.KJV: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
texts.NASB95:
Because for Your sake I have borne reproach;
Dishonor has covered my face.
texts.NKJV:
Because for Your sake I have borne reproach;
Shame has covered my face.
texts.DRB: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
texts.ESV:
For it is for your sake that I have borne reproach,
    that dishonor has covered my face.

texts.NIV84: I am a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my own mother's sons;
texts.KJV: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
texts.NASB95:
I have become estranged from my brothers
And an alien to my mother’s sons.
texts.NKJV:
I have become a stranger to my brothers,
And an alien to my mother’s children;
texts.DRB: I am become a stranger to my brethren, and an alien to the sons of my mother.
texts.ESV:
I have become a stranger to my brothers,
    an alien to my mother's sons.

texts.NIV84: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.
texts.KJV: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
texts.NASB95:
For zeal for Your house has consumed me,
And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.
texts.NKJV:
Because zeal for Your house has eaten me up,
And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.
texts.DRB: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up: and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
texts.ESV:
For zeal for your house has consumed me,
    and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

texts.NIV84: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;
texts.KJV: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
texts.NASB95:
When I wept in my soul with fasting,
It became my reproach.
texts.NKJV:
When I wept and chastened my soul with fasting,
That became my reproach.
texts.DRB: And I covered my soul in fasting: and it was made a reproach to me.
texts.ESV:
When I wept and humbled my soul with fasting,
    it became my reproach.

texts.NIV84: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.
texts.KJV: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
texts.NASB95:
When I made sackcloth my clothing,
I became a byword to them.
texts.NKJV:
I also made sackcloth my garment;
I became a byword to them.
texts.DRB: And I made haircloth my garment: and I became a byword to them.
texts.ESV:
When I made sackcloth my clothing,
    I became a byword to them.

texts.NIV84: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.
texts.KJV: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
texts.NASB95:
Those who sit in the gate talk about me,
And I am the song of the drunkards.
texts.NKJV:
Those who sit in the gate speak against me,
And I am the song of the drunkards.
texts.DRB: They that sat in the gate spoke against me: and they that drank wine made me their song.
texts.ESV:
I am the talk of those who sit in the gate,
    and the drunkards make songs about me.

texts.NIV84: But I pray to you, O LORD, in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.
texts.KJV: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
texts.NKJV:
But as for me, my prayer is to You,
O Lord, in the acceptable time;
O God, in the multitude of Your mercy,
Hear me in the truth of Your salvation.
texts.DRB: But as for me, my prayer is to thee, O Lord; for the time of thy good pleasure, O God. In the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
texts.ESV:
But as for me, my prayer is to you, O Lord.
    At an acceptable time, O God,
    in the abundance of your steadfast love answer me in your saving faithfulness.

texts.NIV84: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.
texts.KJV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
texts.NASB95:
Deliver me from the mire and do not let me sink;
May I be delivered from my foes and from the deep waters.
texts.NKJV:
Deliver me out of the mire,
And let me not sink;
Let me be delivered from those who hate me,
And out of the deep waters.
texts.DRB: Draw me out of the mire, that I may not stick fast: deliver me from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
texts.ESV:
Deliver me
    from sinking in the mire;
let me be delivered from my enemies
    and from the deep waters.

texts.NIV84: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.
texts.KJV: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
texts.NASB95:
May the flood of water not overflow me
Nor the deep swallow me up,
Nor the pit shut its mouth on me.
texts.DRB: Let not the tempest of water drown me, nor the deep swallow me up: and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
texts.ESV:
Let not the flood sweep over me,
    or the deep swallow me up,
    or the pit close its mouth over me.

texts.NIV84: Answer me, O LORD, out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.
texts.KJV: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
texts.NASB95:
Answer me, O Lord, for Your lovingkindness is good;
According to the greatness of Your compassion, turn to me,
texts.NKJV:
Hear me, O Lord, for Your lovingkindness is good;
Turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.
texts.DRB: Hear me, O Lord, for thy mercy is kind; look upon me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
texts.ESV:
Answer me, O Lord, for your steadfast love is good;
    according to your abundant mercy, turn to me.

texts.NIV84: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.
texts.KJV: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
texts.NASB95:
And do not hide Your face from Your servant,
For I am in distress; answer me quickly.
texts.DRB: And turn not away thy face from thy servant: for I am in trouble, hear me speedily.
texts.ESV:
Hide not your face from your servant,
    for I am in distress; make haste to answer me.

texts.NIV84: Come near and rescue me; redeem me because of my foes.
texts.KJV: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
texts.NASB95:
Oh draw near to my soul and redeem it;
Ransom me because of my enemies!
texts.NKJV:
Draw near to my soul, and redeem it;
Deliver me because of my enemies.
texts.DRB: Attend to my soul, and deliver it: save me because of my enemies.
texts.ESV:
Draw near to my soul, redeem me;
    ransom me because of my enemies!

texts.NIV84: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.
texts.KJV: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
texts.NASB95:
You know my reproach and my shame and my dishonor;
All my adversaries are before You.
texts.NKJV:
You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor;
My adversaries are all before You.
texts.DRB: Thou knowest my reproach, and my confusion, and my shame.

texts.NIV84: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.
texts.KJV: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
texts.NASB95:
Reproach has broken my heart and I am so sick.
And I looked for sympathy, but there was none,
And for comforters, but I found none.
texts.DRB: In thy sight are all they that afflict me; my heart hath expected reproach and misery. And I looked for one that would grieve together with me, but there was none: and for one that would comfort me, and I found none.
texts.ESV:
Reproaches have broken my heart,
    so that I am in despair.
I looked for pity, but there was none,
    and for comforters, but I found none.

texts.NIV84: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.
texts.KJV: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
texts.NASB95:
They also gave me gall for my food
And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
texts.NKJV:
They also gave me gall for my food,
And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
texts.DRB: And they gave me gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
texts.ESV:
They gave me poison for food,
    and for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink.

texts.NIV84: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.
texts.KJV: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
texts.NASB95:
May their table before them become a snare;
And when they are in peace, may it become a trap.
texts.NKJV:
Let their table become a snare before them,
And their well-being a trap.
texts.DRB: Let their table become as a snare before them, and a recompense, and a stumblingblock.
texts.ESV:
Let their own table before them become a snare;
    and when they are at peace, let it become a trap.

texts.NIV84: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
texts.KJV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
texts.NASB95:
May their eyes grow dim so that they cannot see,
And make their loins shake continually.
texts.NKJV:
Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see;
And make their loins shake continually.
texts.DRB: Let their eyes be darkened that they see not; and their back bend thou down always.
texts.ESV:
Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see,
    and make their loins tremble continually.

texts.NIV84: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.
texts.KJV: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
texts.NASB95:
Pour out Your indignation on them,
And may Your burning anger overtake them.
texts.NKJV:
Pour out Your indignation upon them,
And let Your wrathful anger take hold of them.
texts.DRB: Pour out thy indignation upon them: and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
texts.ESV:
Pour out your indignation upon them,
    and let your burning anger overtake them.

texts.NIV84: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
texts.KJV: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
texts.NASB95:
May their camp be desolate;
May none dwell in their tents.
texts.NKJV:
Let their dwelling place be desolate;
Let no one live in their tents.
texts.DRB: Let their habitation be made desolate: and let there be none to dwell in their tabernacles.
texts.ESV:
May their camp be a desolation;
    let no one dwell in their tents.

texts.NIV84: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.
texts.KJV: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
texts.NASB95:
For they have persecuted him whom You Yourself have smitten,
And they tell of the pain of those whom You have wounded.
texts.NKJV:
For they persecute the ones You have struck,
And talk of the grief of those You have wounded.
texts.DRB: Because they have persecuted him whom thou hast smitten; and they have added to the grief of my wounds.
texts.ESV:
For they persecute him whom you have struck down,
    and they recount the pain of those you have wounded.

texts.NIV84: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.
texts.KJV: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
texts.NASB95:
Add iniquity to their iniquity,
And may they not come into Your righteousness.
texts.NKJV:
Add iniquity to their iniquity,
And let them not come into Your righteousness.
texts.DRB: Add thou iniquity upon their iniquity: and let them not come into thy justice.
texts.ESV:
Add to them punishment upon punishment;
    may they have no acquittal from you.

texts.NIV84: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.
texts.KJV: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
texts.NASB95:
May they be blotted out of the book of life
And may they not be recorded with the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
Let them be blotted out of the book of the living,
And not be written with the righteous.
texts.DRB: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; and with the just let them not be written.
texts.ESV:
Let them be blotted out of the book of the living;
    let them not be enrolled among the righteous.

texts.NIV84: I am in pain and distress; may your salvation, O God, protect me.
texts.KJV: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
texts.NASB95:
But I am afflicted and in pain;
May Your salvation, O God, set me securely on high.
texts.NKJV:
But I am poor and sorrowful;
Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.
texts.DRB: But I am poor and sorrowful: thy salvation, O God, hath set me up.
texts.ESV:
But I am afflicted and in pain;
    let your salvation, O God, set me on high!

texts.NIV84: I will praise God's name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.
texts.KJV: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
texts.NASB95:
I will praise the name of God with song
And magnify Him with thanksgiving.
texts.NKJV:
I will praise the name of God with a song,
And will magnify Him with thanksgiving.
texts.DRB: I will praise the name of God with a canticle: and I will magnify him with praise.
texts.ESV:
I will praise the name of God with a song;
    I will magnify him with thanksgiving.

texts.NIV84: This will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hoofs.
texts.KJV: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
texts.NASB95:
And it will please the Lord better than an ox
Or a young bull with horns and hoofs.
texts.NKJV:
This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bull,
Which has horns and hooves.
texts.DRB: And it shall please God better than a young calf, that bringeth forth horns and hoofs.
texts.ESV:
This will please the Lord more than an ox
    or a bull with horns and hoofs.

texts.NIV84: The poor will see and be glad- you who seek God, may your hearts live!
texts.KJV: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
texts.NASB95:
The humble have seen it and are glad;
You who seek God, let your heart revive.
texts.NKJV:
The humble shall see this and be glad;
And you who seek God, your hearts shall live.
texts.DRB: Let the poor see and rejoice: seek ye God, and your soul shall live.
texts.ESV:
When the humble see it they will be glad;
    you who seek God, let your hearts revive.

texts.NIV84: The LORD hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.
texts.KJV: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
texts.NASB95:
For the Lord hears the needy
And does not despise His who are prisoners.
texts.NKJV:
For the Lord hears the poor,
And does not despise His prisoners.
texts.DRB: For the Lord hath heard the poor: and hath not despised his prisoners.
texts.ESV:
For the Lord hears the needy
    and does not despise his own people who are prisoners.

texts.NIV84: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,
texts.KJV: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
texts.NASB95:
Let heaven and earth praise Him,
The seas and everything that moves in them.
texts.NKJV:
Let heaven and earth praise Him,
The seas and everything that moves in them.
texts.DRB: Let the heavens and the earth praise him; the sea, and every thing that creepeth therein.
texts.ESV:
Let heaven and earth praise him,
    the seas and everything that moves in them.

texts.NIV84: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;
texts.KJV: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
texts.NASB95:
For God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah,
That they may dwell there and possess it.
texts.NKJV:
For God will save Zion
And build the cities of Judah,
That they may dwell there and possess it.
texts.DRB: For God will save Sion, and the cities of Juda shall be built up. And they shall dwell there, and acquire it by inheritance.

texts.NIV84: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.
texts.KJV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
texts.NASB95:
The descendants of His servants will inherit it,
And those who love His name will dwell in it.
texts.NKJV:
Also, the descendants of His servants shall inherit it,
And those who love His name shall dwell in it.
texts.DRB: And the seed of his servants shall possess it; and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
texts.ESV:
the offspring of his servants shall inherit it,
    and those who love his name shall dwell in it.

texts.NIV84: Hasten, O God, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.
texts.KJV: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.
texts.NASB95:
O God, hasten to deliver me;
O Lord, hasten to my help!
texts.NKJV:
Make haste, O God, to deliver me!
Make haste to help me, O Lord!
texts.DRB: Unto the end, a psalm for David, to bring to remembrance that the Lord saved him. O God, come to my assistance; O Lord, make haste to help me.
texts.ESV:
Make haste, O God, to deliver me!
    O Lord, make haste to help me!

texts.NIV84: May those who seek my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
texts.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
texts.NASB95:
Let those be ashamed and humiliated
Who seek my life;
Let those be turned back and dishonored
Who delight in my hurt.
texts.NKJV:
Let them be ashamed and confounded
Who seek my life;
Let them be turned back and confused
Who desire my hurt.
texts.DRB: Let them be confounded and ashamed that seek my soul:
texts.ESV:
Let them be put to shame and confusion
    who seek my life!
Let them be turned back and brought to dishonor
    who delight in my hurt!

texts.NIV84: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.
texts.KJV: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
texts.NASB95:
Let those be turned back because of their shame
Who say, “Aha, aha!”
texts.NKJV:
Let them be turned back because of their shame,
Who say, “Aha, aha!”
texts.DRB: Let them be turned backward, and blush for shame that desire evils to me: Let them be presently turned away blushing for shame that say to me: 'T is well, 't is well.
texts.ESV:
Let them turn back because of their shame
    who say, “Aha, Aha!”

texts.NIV84: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "Let God be exalted!"
texts.KJV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
texts.DRB: Let all that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; and let such as love thy salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.
texts.ESV:
May all who seek you
    rejoice and be glad in you!
May those who love your salvation
    say evermore, “God is great!”

texts.NIV84: Yet I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
texts.KJV: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.
texts.DRB: But I am needy and poor; O God, help me. Thou art my helper and my deliverer: O Lord, make no delay.
